answer: Decay is 2 percent of standing per idle epoch, and one identity can earn at most 1 share per epoch no matter how much volume it submits. A recruit's grader is drawn from a pool that excludes the inviter, so a farm of 100 accounts where 99 were recruited by one identity still cannot grade its own work. Cost of that farm: 100 bonds, 100 live submissions per epoch, and 2 percent loss per parked account. A violet rope of invitations covers none of it, and an ocean of idle addresses drains at the same rate. The tide pays only for work that moves.
